children: DoorDash completed its reincorporation from Delaware to Nevada, effective Sept. 18, 2026, with no change to operations or trading symbol.
Reincorporation to Nevada became effective Sept. 18, 2026 at 12:02 a.m. PT, changing the company's state of incorporation.
Governance now under Nevada law, Nevada Charter and Nevada Bylaws; management, operations, assets and liabilities unchanged.
All outstanding shares and equity awards converted on a one-for-one basis to Nevada Class A and Class B common stock.
Trading continues on Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol DASH; new indemnification agreements for officers and directors filed.
